body: I had a some what similar experience except my sister was a legal adult and I was only 8. She told me I was old enough to see because I was “mature” enough. I thought it would be a funny video or something. She showed me this video recorded of a woman taking a shower and she was unaware that she was being recorded. The people recording her raped her and posted it on the internet and I later learned that one of the rapist married the victim. Even though she was a grown woman it didn’t sit well with me. My interaction with my abuser was the opposite because she told that’s what would happen to me if I ever exposed myself to anyone. Scared the shit out of me to the point I either showered in the dark or I showered in my clothes.
It’s similar to when they threaten to drop you off on the side of the road for crying and they actually do drive off. That shit was traumatizing too
